basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old financial analyst based in London. I have a keen interest in personal finance, investment strategies, and educational resources for career advancement. I usually browse Reddit during the early evenings after work and sometimes on weekends. I'm in a long-term relationship and enjoy discussing financial tips and strategies with like-minded individuals. My dislikes include spammy content and misinformation.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in finance, with a degree in Economics from a UK university. I work as a financial analyst and have been self-teaching investment strategies, particularly options trading. I frequently engage with educational content to keep up with the latest trends and strategies.
